column2: the plan places the conditional `approval-gates-explicit.md` read at step 3.5 entry (immediately after the mandatory `approval-gates.md` read and before "execute the gate b body") whenever `approve_requested=true`. that runs before gate b's zero-findings short-circuit and before mode selection, so `--per-round-approval` runs with empty `accepted-plan-findings.md` still load ~36 explicit-mode lines with no prompt work. the same early load can also run on post-apply resume paths where idempotency routes to settle without re-prompting. this contradicts the plan's own zero-findings edge case and partially defeats the context-saving goal.
